steps.text: Prove existence by explicitly constructing the sequence of nonnegative continuous functions.
Partition [0,1] into consecutive intervals I_n with length 1/(n(n+1)), using the telescoping sum.
Choose the supports of the tent functions to be disjoint, exactly on the intervals I_n, so the bumps do not interfere.
The sup norms are 1/n, so the sum of sup norms diverges by the harmonic series.
At each x at most one term is nonzero, so bound the tail sup by 1/(N+1), which tends to zero.
